in_marathi.name: Naran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Man
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Naran is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nara', which means 'man'. In Hindu mythology, Naran refers to Lord Rama, an avatar of the god Vishnu and the protagonist of the epic Ramayana. Naran is believed to embody the ideals of courage, wisdom, and devotion.
